content:
Hi,
I'm sharing my first "serious" Lean project. It is a formalization of aspects of relational calculus and relational logic.

https://github.com/AviCraimer/relational-calculus-library-lean4/tree/main

This is a work in progress but I thought it was far enough along it might be of interest to some. I hope it might be helpful as an educational resource for people (including myself) to learn about the relational calculus. One day it might also be useful as a verified foundation to guide implementations of relational programming systems for practical use.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if you are interested in the project.

Avi
